name: 大腸ポリポーシス

summary.text: A rare intestinal polyposis syndrome characterized by the development of up to hundreds to thousands of adenomas in the large bowel. It is a multi-system disorder with important extracolonic manifestations.
summary.evidence: A rare intestinal polyposis syndrome cha
